articles.title: Hwy. 400 ramps to Hwy. 401 reopen after 3-vehicle crash
articles.summary: The Highway 400 ramps to eastbound Highway 401 have reopened after a three-vehicle crash on Thursday morning. Ontario Provincial Police (OPP) say the crash happened around 12:40 a.m. and cleanup is expected to take several hours. articles.title: Loblaw reports Q2 profit of $751M, as revenue and sales up from a year ago
articles.summary: BRAMPTON — Loblaw Cos. Ltd. reported its second-quarter profit and revenue rose compared with a year ago.

articles.title: Toronto police charge Hamilton man in 2006 cold-case homicide after breakthrough DNA match
articles.summary: On July 29, members of the Toronto Police Homicide and Missing Persons Unit arrested Pierre O'Connor, 43, of Hamilton, charging him with first‑degree murder in Santos' killing.

articles.title: Trial of man accused of killing his nine-year-old daughter set to continue today
articles.summary: ELIZABETHTOWN — The trial of a man accused of killing his nine-year-old daughter last summer during a trip to New York is scheduled to continue today.

articles.title: 1 dead after crash between e-scooter, motor vehicle near Tommy Thompson Park: Toronto police
articles.summary: The rider of an e-scooter died in hospital after a collision near Toronto's waterfront Wednesday evening, police say.

articles.title: Man, 43, killed in e-scooter crash near Tommy Thompson Park
articles.summary: A man is dead following a collision between a commercial van and an e-scooter near Tommy Thompson Park. Toronto police say the crash involving the driver of a Mercedes and an e-scooter rider occurred just before 7:45 p.m. Wednesday in the Leslie Street and Unwin Avenue area. articles.title: Toronto residents push for moratorium on data centres in city, raise concerns over environmental impact
articles.summary: Some Toronto residents are demanding a one-year moratorium on two proposed data centre projects in the city's Etobicoke and Scarborough areas.

articles.title: Toronto council demands Ford government return land province took for rejected Billy Bishop Airport expansion
articles.summary: This spring, the province passed a law allowing it to take over municipal land for its planned expansion of Billy Bishop Airport. On Wednesday, days after the federal government rejected the province's proposal for the island airport, Toronto city council voted to demand the Ford government give it back.

articles.title: No criminal charges to be laid in alleged Oshawa courthouse assault of lawyer, investigation finds
articles.summary: York Regional Police will not be proceeding with criminal charges against Durham Regional Police Service officers following an investigation into the arrest and alleged assault of a lawyer at the Oshawa courthouse earlier this year.

articles.title: Oakville councillor remembered as 'trusted friend, colleague' after sudden death
articles.summary: After 23 years of service to the Town of Oakville, Coun. Marc Reyer Grant passed away on Monday from a "sudden illness," said friend and former councillor Jeff Knoll.

articles.title: Peel Region shelter crisis deepens as intimate partner violence incidents rise
articles.summary: As intimate partner violence incidents rise in Peel Region, local leaders say provincially funded emergency shelters are overburdened and hamstrung by outdated funding rules. Mississauga’s mayor and the Peel Regional Council have called for more support.

articles.title: Allan Gardens could get a major greenhouse expansion if the city puts in $10M: councillor
articles.summary: A Toronto councillor and volunteer-based community organization are calling on the city to put $9 million more toward expanding the Allan Gardens greenhouse complex.

articles.title: Ontario rethinking support for high-speed rail after feds reject Billy Bishop expansion: source
articles.summary: The federal government's rejection of a plan to allow commercial jets at Toronto's Billy Bishop Airport is threatening a wedge between the Ford government and Ottawa — and potentially strengthening opposition to a major high-speed rail project.
